name: Vespexer (Drinax Wasteland)
description: A Vespexer — one of the tribes who wander the blasted surface of Drinax. Two hundred years ago the Aslan wiped out your world and condemned your ancestors to a living hell. The King in his floating palace may claim you as one of his subjects, but the Vespexers kneel to no-one.

traits.name: Wasteland Survivor
traits.description: Raised on the blasted, Aslan-ravaged surface of Drinax, Vespexers are extraordinarily tough. DM+1 to all Survival checks and END characteristic checks to endure hardship, exposure, or starvation. They begin play with Survival 0 as a free background skill.

traits.name: Hatred of the Aslan
traits.description: Two centuries of racial memory do not fade easily. Vespexers gain DM+1 to checks involving Recon, Stealth, or combat against Aslan opponents. However, DM-1 on Diplomat and Persuade checks when dealing with Aslan — the hatred is difficult to conceal.
